items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: jingles and record dates and Nelson Riddle

ctx.x: Then I went to work at Universal; I used to do an awful lot of work at Universal. That's where Hank Mancini heard me, and he hired me, and I worked for Hank, not on a... I was his pianist. I worked for him for seventeen years. But all we did was pictures and concerts. So it wasn't like a steady job, you know. Like, if you were to exist on the money you made with Hank Mancini, you'd starve. But whenever you did work with Mancini, you made money. You had a three-day picture, and then the next week you'd make an…

And in the meantime, I was doing all the rest of this studio work -- jingles and record dates and Nelson Riddle and Billy May and you name it, with everybody...even Pete Rugolo. You name it. I was in there. I was hot. And it was driving me crazy. I finally took a staff job at NBC, and signed up for three years.
